definitions.measured_takeover: p3_sequence: second C->N; p2_c_to_n: the C->N; baselines: RAPTOR re-capture after its 200 ms setpoint timeout
definitions.motor_rms: RMS over [change, change+0.5 s) (1 ms zero-order hold) and four motors of run minus the in-batch baseline mean curve of the unit (config p4.baseline_condition) aligned at its re-capture; baseline runs use the leave-one-out mean
definitions.gru_distance: Euclidean distance between the committed GRU at the given offset after the change and the in-batch baseline mean at the same offset after its re-capture
definitions.group_ci: mean and two-sided 95% t interval (Student t, n-1 dof) over the runs of one group
definitions.ratio_ci: (N0 - Nx)/(N0 - baseline) from group means; 95% percentile bootstrap interval resampling runs with replacement within each of the three groups independently, 20000 resamples, numpy default_rng(master_seed); resamples with |N0 - baseline| < 1e-9 dropped
definitions.cost_decomposition: Total cost of a C->N = N0 - baseline (per metric). Part removed by the memory treatment = (N0 - Nx)/(N0 - baseline); the remainder 1 - ratio is attributed to RAPTOR zero-velocity target capture (the takeover target is unchanged in all treatments).
definitions.takeover_state: speed along the motion axis at the change and mean EKF acceleration along it over [change - 50 ms, change] (p4_metrics)

scope: One frozen candidate, headless SITL only. Each run has its own Gazebo seed (and heading in 01a); intervals describe run-to-run variation of this SITL setup.
